verdict.rationale: The API is clearly versioned. Parse has distinct v1 and v2 APIs with a documented v1-to-v2 migration guide, and calls take an explicit `version` parameter. Docs keep a dedicated /deprecated/ section, SDKs are semver-versioned, and the GitHub repo tells users to migrate to the new packages. However, no formal deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines, support windows) is documented. missing for 10: a published deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, API changelog or versioning guarantees, independent corroboration of how deprecations are handled in practice.
